basic_info.main_problem: I believe that after being Recently divorced, I will never find a good spouse again, which makes me feel despair and Loneliness.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizing that I have fallen into negative thinking patterns that have affected my belief in finding love again, therefore seeking counseling.

core_beliefs: I am doomed to never have a happy intimate relationship again
at my age, and divorced, no one will want to choose me

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if one marriage fails, it means I can never have a happy, stable intimate relationship again
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids starting new intimate relationships, instead distracting himself with work and interests
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: this proves I can never find a good partner again

special_situations.event: Seeing happy couples in daily life
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if others all have happy relationships and I have no partner, it means I have failed and am doomed to Loneliness
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing situations, reducing interaction with unfamiliar opposite sex
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will always be this lonely

special_situations.event: Thinks of dating again or attending activities where she might meet new people
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I try dating, I will definitely be Being rejected or disappointed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: simply not trying, to avoid being hurt and disappointed again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: trying is useless, it will only feel worse in the end

special_situations.event: considering confiding Loneliness and hopelessness to close friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express vulnerability and pain, I will be judged or looked down on by others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: staying Silence, not revealing true feelings to friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: they will think I am melodramatic, looking down on me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and loved, to rebuild a stable and intimate partner relationship
core_conflict.fear: fear of Being rejected, being hurt again and being judged
defense_goal: reducing the risk of Being rejected by avoiding dating and emotional exposure
maintaining a sense of control with seemingly rational reasons and Self-protection

object_relations.self_representation: a lonely person who may not be chosen
object_relations.object_representation: Others (potential partners or friends) are people prone to judge and reject him

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor discusses trying dating again or joining a book club or community activities
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: believing 'trying will lead to Being rejected', pre-assigning potential negative evaluations to others
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: listing realistic difficulties (age,Divorced experience, few opportunities) in a calm but hesitant tone, emphasizing 'now is not the right time to try'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to consider sharing feelings with friends and seeking support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: assuming friends will look down on or blame oneself, attributing inner self-criticism to others' intentions (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: using cautious, avoidant phrasing, like 'they probably think I am exaggerating', reducing details, avoiding depth.

manifestations: persistently feeling Loneliness and hopelessness after Divorce
intensified loneliness when Seeing happy couples
not expressing true feelings to friends due to shyness and fear of judgment

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: In sessions, repeatedly expresses fear of being judged by friends and appearing 'overly sentimental', being overly cautious about self-exposure
appearing hesitant when discussing Attending social activities and emphasizing possible negative consequences

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: repeatedly assuming 'they will look down on me/think I am exaggerating' when discussing seeking help from friends, attributing inner worries to others' thoughts

exception_events.target_problem: when facing social and relationship expansion after Divorce, the client usually avoids starting new connections due to hopelessness and shyness, resulting in persistent Loneliness.
exception_events.unique_outcome: for a period after Divorce, the client reconnected with an old friend and had several pleasant, meaningful conversations, not avoiding closeness as usual at the time, experiencing a sense of connection.
exception_events.reason: different context/support: the other was a familiar old friend, the interaction non-romantic, lower evaluation pressure, thus more willing to engage.

positive_force: Has several close friends who can provide support
able to actively seek professional help and willing to Reflect on thought patterns
Willing to try expanding the social circle through book clubs and community activities
Once built meaningful connections with old friends, showing the ability to build relationships
negative_force: negative cognitive patterns like catastrophizing, overgeneralization, black-and-white and predicting the future
Shyness and excessive worry about others' evaluations lead to avoiding self-disclosure
avoiding dating and social attempts, easing anxiety short-term but maintaining the problem
Sleep disturbance and Decreased attention, weakening daily functioning and self-efficacy

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids starting new intimate relationships / dates
antecedent: Thinks of finding a partner again or attending activities where she might meet new people
pessimistic associations about one's prospects after Seeing happy couples
Worrying about being judged by friends or potential partners

target_behavior.function: escaping potential rejection and disappointment, temporarily reducing anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: limited social circle, persistent Loneliness and hopelessness, perpetuating negative beliefs about relationships

target_behavior.behavior: repeated nightly worry about the future causing insomnia
antecedent: recalling Divorce and future relationship prospects before sleep
Ruminating at night after seeing couples during the day
target_behavior.core_reason: Emotional reasoning and catastrophizing, lacking effective emotion regulation and relaxation strategies
target_behavior.function: trying to gain control or prevent bad outcomes through repeated thinking (inner negative Reinforcement)
target_behavior.consequence: Declining sleep quality, next-day attention and Decline in work performance, worsened Low mood
